editorialRules: Abertura situada, explicação conectada e consequência compreensível
EN e PT exprimem o mesmo conteúdo

integration.load: Load after heritage-content.js, before initialization; apply after Living.initContent has merged the 50 readings.
integration.readings: Match by id and copy paragraphs, en, pt without changing remaining metadata.
integration.translations: Resolve scope content -> V.content, resident -> V.learning.residents by id, culturalContent -> V.culturalContent; validate expectedEn, then copy pt and ptByGrade. contextPt is separate educational context.
integration.dialogue: Before original Dialogue.start, clone each line and resolve ptByGrade with V.lang; match dialogueTranslations by existing en and pt, replace correctedEn/correctedPt or ptByGrade while preserving speaker, choices and callbacks.
integration.figures: Match V.heritageContent.figures by id, validate expectedFacts, then copy enFacts.

verificationLimits: Text and schema reviewed locally; browser interaction and visual typography belong to the main integration checks.
